thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=rate-limiter-svc env=prod — spike of 429s and connection timeouts in EU cluster. PD incident: P12345

pagerduty-bot: pagerduty: Incident P12345 — unacked. Escalation policy: primary oncall.

alice_oncall: acked — I'm on it. seeing dashboards show 5xx/429 upslope starting ~1714001180. pinging infra. :eyes:

cheng: checking rate-limiter logs and recent config rollouts. quick summary: a deploy rolled out a new "rate_thermostat" adaptive backoff yesterday. pulling logs now.

nate: if thermostat is misfiring we might see global backoffs. can we flip to conservative mode? how do we toggle it?

raj: the toggle is config: rate_thermostat.mode = "adaptive" | "conservative" | "off". ops-configs has recent change: 1713998200 by infra-batch.

alice_oncall: can someone run a quick query to confirm affected tenants and error classes? I want a customer-impact blurb for PD.

cheng: query running:
```
SELECT tenant_id, count(*) as failures, region
FROM requests
WHERE status_code IN (429, 500) AND ts > 1714001000
GROUP BY tenant_id, region
ORDER BY failures DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

cheng: top results: tenant: acme-eu (12k failures), tenant: fastpay-eu (3.1k), tenant: aaa-eu (900). Region: eu-west-1 primarily. rates peaked ~1200 rps failing.

nate: ok that matches what I'm seeing in grafana. latency low, but 429s from limiter returning early. sounds like throttle decision surface is too aggressive.

alice_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) flip rate_thermostat to conservative 2) if that fails, set off and fallback to static per-tenant quotas 3) rollback recent ops-config change. Who can flip it now?

raj: I can flip now. executing:
```
# opsctl set-config rate-limiter-svc rate_thermostat.mode=conservative --env prod --region eu-west-1
opsctl: accepted; change planned, deploying to control-plane.
```

deploy-bot: control-plane update started for rate-limiter-svc cfg-id=cfg-20240315-71 in eu-west-1. progress: 0/6 control nodes updated.

alice_oncall: thanks raj. I'll keep PD updated: initial impact: multiple EU tenants seeing 20-70% of requests returning 429 over past 10m. Working on rollback if toggle doesn't reduce 429s within 2m.

cheng: logs after toggle (30s): still seeing elevated 429s but rate reduced ~30%. some nodes still on old config.

nate: can we expedite rollout? maybe force synchronous control node update for eu cluster?

raj: forcing:
```
opsctl apply-sync cfg-20240315-71 --target eu-west-1 --force
```

deploy-bot: control-plane update in progress: 4/6 nodes updated.

alice_oncall: PD update: we've toggled the adaptive thermostat to conservative; hit rate of 429s down ~40% overall. partial mitigation, still degraded for top tenant (acme-eu). continuing.

cheng: running targeted per-tenant override for acme-eu to ensure they have higher quota while we stabilize:
```
opsctl set-tenant-quota acme-eu --requests-per-min 12000 --env prod --region eu-west-1
```

nate: acme-eu quota override applied. monitoring.

pagerduty-bot: pagerduty: Incident P12345 — acknowledged by alice_oncall. escalation paused.

alice_oncall: after override + thermostat toggle: acme-eu 429s dropped to ~2% of traffic in last 5m. overall 429 rate returning close to baseline but still noisy.

raj: root cause hypothesis: new "rate_thermostat" adaptive algorithm overestimated congestion due to a telemetry miscalculation when node heartbeat sampling failed briefly. when heartbeat gap > 3s the thermostat enters aggressive backoff. a recent control-plane change changed heartbeat timeout from 5s->3s.

cheng: saving logs and config diffs for postmortem. snippet of problematic hj trace:
```
[rate-thermostat] sample_count=0 heartbeat_gap_ms=4200 -> mode=adaptive -> backoff=0.75
[rate-thermostat] applied token_reset=0.3 tenants=acme-eu
```

alice_oncall: immediate followups: 1) revert heartbeat timeout change (ops) 2) add guard in thermostat: require >=2 nonzero samples before aggressive backoff 3) postmortem + customer comms draft. assign owners? raj for revert, cheng for patch, nate to lead postmortem. I'll own comms.

raj: revert in progress: opsctl rollback-config --cfg-id cfg-1713998200 --env prod --region eu-west-1 -> rollback complete.

deploy-bot: rollback applied to control-plane nodes: all eu nodes now using heartbeat=5s.

alice_oncall: monitoring: looks stable. 429s trending to baseline over last 5m. I'll start de-escalation in PD after confirming 15m stable.

pagerduty-bot: pagerduty: Incident P12345 — auto-deescalation scheduled after 15m stable.

alice_oncall: quick customer-impact note for ops/triage channel: impacted tenants: acme-eu (12k failures), fastpay-eu (3.1k), aaa-eu (900). ETA for full recovery: ~T+20m. root cause: control-plane heartbeat timeout change causing adaptive thermostat to enter overly aggressive backoff. mitigation: thermostat toggled -> conservative, per-tenant quota override, control-plane rollback. postmortem owners assigned.

nate: adding monitoring alert to catch aggressive backoff triggers: alert if rate_thermostat.backoff > 0.5 AND heartbeat_gap_ms > 3000 for >30s.

cheng: saved traces, config diffs, logs to /var/incident/P12345/ for postmortem.

alice_oncall: thanks all. closing this thread when PD deescalates. follow-up doc: postmortem + customer email draft in #incidents-docs. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident P12345: status=stable, last_update=1714001648.
